build_constant_lr_scheduler: build a ConstantLRScheduler to keep the learning rate fixed during local FL training
create_armijo_line_search: create an ArmijoLineSearch scheduler that performs backtracking line search to select optimal step size
build_multistep_lr_scheduler: build a MultiStepLRScheduler to decay the learning rate at specified milestone rounds
create_step_lr_scheduler: create a StepLRScheduler to decay the learning rate by gamma every step_size rounds
build_lr_batch_size_normalizer: build an LRBatchSizeNormalizer to normalize the learning rate by the number of examples in the batch
